title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks rise on reports of Trump offering 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran
title_zh: FTSE 100 LIVE：有报道称特朗普向伊朗提出 15 点停火计划，股市上涨
summary: The plan was submitted to Iran by intermediaries from Pakistan, who have offered to host renewed negotiations between Washington and Tehran.
summary_zh: 该计划是由巴基斯坦的中间人提交给伊朗的，他们提出主办华盛顿和德黑兰之间的新谈判。

title: Arm Rises on Plan to Sell Own Chips With Meta as Anchor Customer
title_zh: Arm 计划以 Meta 作为主要客户销售自有芯片
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Shares of Arm Holdings Plc, which made its name licensing technology to semiconductor makers, rose in premarket trading after it said it will sell its own chips for the first time, in a move forecast to generate about $15 billion annually within five years.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——以向半导体制造商授权技术而闻名的 Arm Holdings Plc 表示将首次出售自己的芯片，预计此举将在五年内每年产生约 150 亿美元的收入，该公司股价在盘前交易中上涨。

title: Meta Glasses Withheld From EU Over Battery Rules, Supply Snags
title_zh: 因电池规定和供应障碍，Meta Glass 被欧盟扣留
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc.’s rollout of new display-equipped Ray-Ban smart glasses in the European Union has been hampered by battery and artificial intelligence regulations in addition to supply constraints.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Meta Platforms Inc. 在欧盟推出配备显示屏的新型雷朋智能眼镜，除了供应限制外，还受到电池和人工智能法规的阻碍。

title: February shipments of foreign-branded phones in China fall 7.7% from a year ago, CAICT data shows
title_zh: 中国信息通信研究院数据显示，2月份中国外资品牌手机出货量同比下降7.7%
summary: Shipments of foreign-branded ‌mobile phones in ‌China for February, including Apple's ​iPhones, fell 7.7% from the same month last year, Reuters calculations ‌based on ⁠data released by a government-affiliated research ⁠firm on Wednesday showed.
summary_zh: 路透社根据一家政府附属研究公司周三发布的数据计算显示，2 月份包括苹果 iPhone 在内的外国品牌手机在中国的出货量比去年同月下降了 7.7%。

title: Exclusive-Reliance Jio woos investors to sell 8% of individual stakes in IPO, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，Reliance Jio 吸引投资者在 IPO 中出售 8% 的个人股份
summary: By Kane Wu, Aditya Kalra and Vibhuti Sharma HONG KONG/NEW DELHI, March 25 (Reuters) - Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Jio Platforms has held talks with 13 marquee foreign investors to sell
summary_zh: 作者：Kane Wu、Aditya Kalra 和 Vibhuti Sharma 香港/新德里，3 月 25 日（路透社）——印度亿万富翁穆克什·安巴尼 (Mukesh Ambani) 的 Reliance Jio 平台已与 13 个大型外国投资者就出售事宜进行了谈判

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures jump on reports US sent ceasefire plan to Iran
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货因美国向伊朗发出停火计划的报道而上涨
summary: Wall Street is weighing reports that the US has approached Iran with a plan to halt fighting.
summary_zh: 华尔街正在考虑有关美国已与伊朗接触并制定停止战斗计划的报道。
